items.exampleEn: Our server brought the menu and some water.
items.exampleZh: 我們的服務生送來菜單和一些水。

items.exampleEn: The pub near our office serves good lunches.
items.exampleZh: 我們辦公室附近那家酒吧供應很不錯的午餐。

items.exampleEn: December is a festive time in many countries.
items.exampleZh: 在許多國家，十二月是充滿節慶氣氛的時節。

items.exampleEn: The hotel lost our booking, so we had to wait.
items.exampleZh: 飯店把我們的預訂弄丟了，所以我們只好等。

items.exampleEn: There is a takeaway next to the station.
items.exampleZh: 車站旁邊有一家外帶餐館。
items.glossZh: 外帶餐點；外帶餐館；（英式）

items.exampleEn: The hotel has a self-service breakfast.
items.exampleZh: 這家飯店的早餐是自助式的。

items.sentenceEn: The server was kind and quick.
items.sentenceZh: 那位服務生親切又俐落。

items.audioEn: Refreshments will be in Room 3 during the break. Please don't bring drinks into the training room.
items.audioZh: 休息時間茶點會放在 3 號室，請不要把飲料帶進訓練教室。
items.questionZh: 休息時間茶點放在哪裡？

items.sentenceEn: Is the restaurant self-service, or do we order at the table?
items.sentenceZh: 這家餐廳是自助式的，還是在桌邊點餐？

items.sentenceEn: The pub was full, so we went to a cafe instead.
items.sentenceZh: 那家酒吧客滿了，所以我們改去咖啡店。

items.stemEn: I called the restaurant to change our ____ from seven to eight.
items.stemZh: 我打電話給餐廳，把我們的訂位從七點改到八點。

items.stemEn: The office party was very ____, with music and colorful lights.
items.stemZh: 公司派對很有節慶氣氛，有音樂和五彩繽紛的燈光。

items.passageEn: To all staff: Our end-of-year dinner will be on December 18 at Murphy's, the pub on Main Street. I have made a booking for forty people. Light refreshments will be served at 6:30, and dinner starts at 7:00. Dinner is not self-service; a server will bring the food to each table. The food there is tasty, and soft drinks are also available. The company will pay, so the meal is a treat for your hard work.
items.passageZh: 全體員工請注意：我們的年終晚餐將於 12 月 18 日在 Main Street 上的 Murphy's 酒吧舉行。我已經訂了四十個人的位子。6:30 會先提供簡單的茶點，晚餐 7:00 開始。晚餐不是自助式的，服務生會把餐點送到每一桌。那裡的菜很好吃，也有無酒精飲料可選。費用由公司支付，這頓飯是犒賞大家辛勤的工作。

referenceEn: Let's order a takeaway for dinner tonight.
rubricZh: 「叫外帶」可寫，例如 get／order／have a takeaway 等
表示提議的寫法都可以（例如 Let's…、Shall we…?、Why don't we…?）

items.promptZh: 我們準備了一些茶點給來參觀的客人。
referenceEn: We prepared some refreshments for the visitors.
We have prepared refreshments for our visitors.
rubricZh: 用 refreshments 表示「茶點」（複數，例如 some refreshments）
時態可用 prepared、have prepared 等
